gaps.requirement: Working hours must not exceed 48 regular hours per week. Overtime must not exceed 12 hours per week and must be voluntary.
gaps.display_title: Cap Working Hours to SA8000 Limit
gaps.factory_status: NON_CONFORMANT — independent audit shows 54 hrs/week average, overtime not documented as voluntary
gaps.recommendation: Cap regular hours at 48, introduce formal voluntary overtime sign-off process, re-audit within 3 months.

gaps.requirement: Establish and implement a due diligence policy identifying human rights and environmental risks in operations and supply chain.
gaps.factory_status: MISSING — no documented CSDDD due diligence policy. Tier-2 suppliers not mapped.
gaps.recommendation: Draft and adopt board-level supply chain due diligence policy. Map all tier-2 suppliers before CSDDD Phase 1 deadline.

gaps.requirement: Publish annual Modern Slavery and Human Trafficking Statement approved by board, signed by director, linked from homepage.
gaps.factory_status: MISSING — statement not published on company website. Only shared informally with buyers via email.
gaps.recommendation: Publish formal s.54 statement on company website. Obtain board sign-off.

contradictions.claim: All working hours within statutory limits / Factory fully SA8000 compliant
contradictions.evidence: Independent audit measured 54 hrs/week average — exceeds SA8000 48-hour regular week limit
contradictions.impact: The SA8000-compliance claim is undercut by a 54-hour audited week, exceeding the 48-hour regular-week limit.
